text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for the smart routing + fallback PRD. Several customer asks (Acme, Nebula) want region affinity + compatible model variants. Can we triage MVP vs stretch? cc @Kevin Patel @Sophie Le :eyes:
Kevin Patel: Echo. Proposal: MVP = tiered routing by customer plan + region affinity. Fallback order: 1) compatible model variant in same region, 2) compatible in other region, 3) degrade to cheaper model family. Stretch: per-request cost/quality signals and cost-aware routing.
Sophie Le: MVP acceptance criteria draft: 1) routing decision < 50ms p95, 2) fallback only to compatible model (same tokenizer + KV cache format) and quality delta < 10% on canonical eval, 3) decision audit logs per request, 4) per-customer pinning honored. Feedback?
Rajiv Kumar: +1 but "compatible model" needs a formal matrix. Fields: architecture, tokenizer id, max seq, kv-cache encoding, quantization format. I can draft.
Maria Chen: Agree on matrix. Also add "acceptable perf delta" definitions: latency delta + quality delta per workload type (chat/gen vs embeddings). We should define canonical evals for top 5 customers.
Kevin Patel: Rollout gates: canary 5% customers, target metrics: error rate, end-to-end latency, quality regression < 1% on eval set. Add immediate automatic fallback to previous stable routing on regressions.
Sophie Le: Edge cases we should call out: model variant removed from catalog, cross-region capacity outage, customer pinned to a model version absent from fallback pool. Proposed behavior: prefer explicit error + clear retry semantics.
Rajiv Kumar: For pinned customers we should surface an explicit error code. Prefer returning 503 with body {"code":"fallback_unavailable","retry_after":secs} for automatic fallbacks. For pin conflicts return 409 w/ instruction to contact support.
Maria Chen: Action items: Raj to draft compatibility matrix + sample JSON policy schema; Sophie to write acceptance criteria + eval plan in PRD; Kevin to produce rollout + observability checklist and failure-mode playbook. Aim: RFC review next Tue.
ops-bot: Reminder: new RFC template uploaded: https://redwood.internal/rfcs. Please attach draft by Mon EOD or ping #eng-platform for exceptions.
Kevin Patel: :thumbsup: I'll sketch a policy snippet for the PRD (example):
```json
{
  "policy_id": "policy.smart_routing.v1",
  "priority_tiers": ["enterprise","standard","free"],
  "fallback_order": ["same_region_compatible","cross_region_compatible","cheapest_compatible"],
  "compatibility_rules": {"tokenizer_match": true, "max_seq_delta": 0, "kv_format": ["v1","v2"]}
}
```
Maria Chen: If everyone OK I'll mark this MVP scope and flag for next roadmap sync. :eyes:
Sophie Le: :thumbsup: from me. I'll start the acceptance criteria doc and attach example eval prompts.
Rajiv Kumar: On it. Posting matrix by EOD and running a quick PM survey for customer priority list.
Maria Chen: Great — thanks everyone. We'll collate and open RFC thread once Raj posts the matrix.
